def parse_int_list(s):
    t = s.strip()
    if len(t) >= 2 and t[0] == '[' and t[-1] == ']':
        t = t[1:len(t)-1]
    parts = t.split(',')
    out = []
    for p in parts:
        q = p.strip()
        if q != '':
            out.append(int(q))
    return out

def parse_probe_config(s):
    items = []
    t = s.strip()
    if t == '[]' or t == '':
        return items
    inner = t[1:len(t)-1]
    chunks = inner.split('},{')
    for i in range(len(chunks)):
        c = chunks[i]
        c = c.replace('{', '')
        c = c.replace('}', '')
        c = c.replace('"', '')
        parts = c.split(',')
        obj = {}
        for j in range(len(parts)):
            part = parts[j]
            kv = part.split(':')
            if len(kv) >= 2:
                key = kv[0].strip()
                val = ':'.join(kv[1:]).strip()
                obj[key] = val
        items.append(obj)
    return items
